channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Sweetgreen: $3 Off Any Order via Cash App Pay
item.guid: Sweetgreen-$3 Off Any Order via Cash App Pay-2026-08-08
item.description: Pay with Cash App in the Sweetgreen app or online after opting in through Cash App to get $3 off your order, valid once per customer through August 15. (Through August 15, 2026)

item.title: Panera Bread: BOGO $5 Entree with Code BOGO5
item.guid: Panera Bread-BOGO $5 Entree with Code BOGO5-2026-08-08
item.description: Use promo code BOGO5 at online or in-app checkout to buy one whole sandwich, market bowl, salad, or soup and get another for just $5. (Limited time)

item.title: Just Salad: 50% Off All Smoothies in August
item.guid: Just Salad-50% Off All Smoothies in August-2026-08-08
item.description: Visit any Just Salad location or order online to get 50% off smoothies throughout the month of August 2026. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Whataburger: BOGO Free Whataburger Today (76th Birthday)
item.description: In honor of Whataburger's 76th birthday on August 8, get a buy-one-get-one-free Whataburger through the app from 11 AM to 8 PM today only, one redemption per Rewards account. (August 8, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu - Chicken, Tenders or Sandwich
item.guid: Popeyes-$5 Faves Menu - Chicken, Tenders or Sand-2026-08-08
item.description: Order from the $5 Faves menu in-store, online, or in the app to get 3-piece Signature Chicken, 3 Tenders, a Chicken Sandwich, or 8-piece Butterfly Shrimp for just $5. (Through August 30, 2026)

item.title: Sonic: $7 Big Deal Meal - Burger, Chicken Bites, Fries, Drink
item.guid: Sonic-$7 Big Deal Meal - Burger, Chicken Bites-2026-08-08
item.description: Get a Sonic Cheeseburger, small Premium Chicken Bites, choice of medium fries or tots, and a medium soft drink or iced tea for $7 at participating locations nationwide. (Limited time)

item.title: Arby's: $7.99 Meat and 3 Box
item.description: Get your choice of Ham and Swiss Melt, Crispy Chicken Sandwich, or Buffalo Chicken Sandwich plus three sides and a small drink for $7.99 at participating locations. (Limited time)

item.title: Domino's: $9.99 Any Pizza, Any Crust, Any Toppings
item.guid: Domino's-$9.99 Any Pizza, Any Crust, Any Toppings-2026-08-08
item.description: Order any pizza at any size with any crust and any toppings for $9.99 online at participating Domino's locations. (Limited time)

item.title: Moe's Southwest Grill: $9.95 Value Meal - Burrito, Chips, Queso and Drink
item.guid: Moe's Southwest Grill-$9.95 Value Meal - Burrito, Chips, Queso-2026-08-08
item.description: Get a full burrito, chips and queso, and a drink bundled for $9.95 at participating Moe's Southwest Grill locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Wendy's: $1 Small Frosty (Chocolate or Vanilla)
item.description: Get a small Classic Chocolate or Vanilla Frosty for $1 when you order online, in the app, drive-thru, or in store through August 23. (Through August 23, 2026)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Chili’s: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili’s-3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.-2026-08-08
item.description: Chili’s all-day 3 For Me bundles a bottomless drink, an appetizer (chips and salsa or house salad), and a full entree starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers - every day at participating locations, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
